what_this_is: Every locked peer's own 8-K Item 2.02 earnings-release history, walked the same way earnings_events.py walks HYP-04's anchor side and run_hyp06_peer_returns_fetch.py walks HYP-06's 25 locked peers -- reportDate, never filingDate; release_session derived from acceptanceDateTime; UNKNOWN left unresolved rather than guessed.
what_this_is_not: Not attributed to a trading-session index -- that happens where the session index is actually built (make_hyp07_phase3_run.py). Not a competitor relationship: these are each peer's OWN earnings, carried only as a days_to_peer_earnings design-matrix control column -- HYP-07's target has no residualization step to use them for, unlike HYP-04/05/06 (see target_signed.py's own docstring, 'DELIBERATELY NOT PORTED').
benchmark_ticker_note: Fetched into the same combined closes CSV as one more ticker; carries NO earnings entry, since build_feature_table_signed never reads days_to_peer_earnings for the benchmark series.
